verdict.rationale: Missive documents a built-in 'AI Assistant/Copilot' that runs long-lived sessions (visible in a session tab), can answer feature questions from docs, and can be granted access to internal APIs/databases/custom tooling via MCP — showing genuine task delegation to an in-product agent (missive-docs-2, missive-docs-3, missive-docs-16, missive-docs-27, missive-docs-34). However, most of the story's emphasis is actually on external AI apps (Claude/ChatGPT) connecting into Missive rather than delegating to Missive's own assistant, and the probe evidence (missive-probe-rt-1/2) documents the reverse pattern (external agent -> Missive) rather than confirming the built-in Copilot's task execution end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the built-in Copilot completing delegated tasks, and clearer first-party documentation distinguishing the internal Copilot's capabilities from the external MCP-server integration.
